programs.name: relative_rival_degree
programs.rationale: Retains reward per active conflict as the main signal and adds modest pressure from rivals weighted relative to the root. Native local aggregates add no feature computation; mutual exclusion among rivals remains unmodeled.

programs.name: population_scaled_pressure
programs.rationale: Blends active conflict count with rival reward measured in units of the current population's average reward. Native aggregates provide global scale without another residual scan; the average can obscure concentrated heavy rivals.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + 0.65 * degree + 0.35 * conflict_weight * remaining_count / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight))

programs.name: sufficient_exchange_priority
programs.rationale: Prioritizes roots whose reward covers the sum of active rival rewards, then ranks other roots by reward share per conflict. This uses a conservative local exchange condition with no added graph work; its priority jump can affect search order.
programs.rule: 1 + weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight) if weight >= conflict_weight else weight / ((1 + degree) * (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight))

programs.name: bounded_turnaround_efficiency
programs.rationale: Applies a bounded, continuous turnaround penalty to reward per active conflict. It uses only native root and neighborhood inputs; summed gaps approximate occupancy but cannot identify the resources shared with individual rivals.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 - 0.15 * degree / (1 + degree) * (station_gap + satellite_gap) / (1 + duration + station_gap + satellite_gap))

programs.name: bounded_weighted_overlap_margin
programs.rationale: Uses minimum-weight overlap among active rivals to discount displaced reward, with the strongest rival retained as a floor. The signed margin only moderately adjusts reward per conflict; local weighted edge enumeration can be quadratic in degree.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.2 * (weight - max(max_conflict_weight, conflict_weight / (1 + max(0, weighted_redundancy)))) / (1 + weight + conflict_weight))

programs.name: bounded_neighbor_packing_pressure
programs.rationale: Penalizes feasible rival packing beyond the strongest individual rival while preserving reward per conflict as the main signal. Reach is restricted to active neighbors; greedy packing and the maximum scan are paid per scored root and may dominate CPU.

programs.name: bounded_compatible_extrema
programs.rationale: Modestly favors roots preserving a stronger compatible peak relative to their strongest conflicting rival. It reaches the full active complement through a maximum scan; repeated residual filtering costs CPU and the two extrema omit longer interactions.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.12 * (compatible_peak_ratio - max_conflict_weight / (1 + weight)) / (1 + compatible_peak_ratio + max_conflict_weight / (1 + weight)))
